question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH best_driver AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.constructor_id, MAX(ds.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE d.year = r.year
    GROUP BY d.year, d.constructor_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT bd.year, bd.constructor_id, bd.best_driver_points, cp.constructor_points, 
           (bd.best_driver_points + cp.constructor_points) as combined_points
    FROM best_driver bd
    JOIN constructor_points cp ON bd.year = cp.year AND bd.constructor_id = cp.constructor_id
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, MAX(combined_points) as max_combined_points
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY constructor_id
    ORDER BY max_combined_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT c.year, c.constructor_id, c.combined_points, con.name as constructor_name, tc.max_combined_points
FROM combined c
JOIN top_constructors tc ON c.constructor_id = tc.constructor_id
JOIN constructors con ON c.constructor_id = con.constructor_id
WHERE c.combined_points = tc.max_combined_points
ORDER BY tc.max_combined_points DESC, c.year
